homepage.title: MediaGo DSP: A Deep Learning-based Intelligent Advertising Platform

meta.description: MediaGo DSP is an intelligent advertising engine based on deep learning technology. MediaGo DSP has established extensive partnerships with premium publishers worldwide to provide high-quality ad inventory, delivering 30 billion+ ad impressions monthly. Utilizing deep neural network technology with 1 billion+ parameters, it processes over 500,000 ad requests per second, evaluates ad performance and develops intelligent bidding strategies in real time.
meta.keywords: MediaGo DSP,Native ads,Display ads,Baidu,Deep Learning Based,Performance Driven,Advertiser Focused,CPC-based Pricing Model
